source: @arbitrum/sdk 4.1.0 (ethers 5.8.0), viem 2.57.4 (abitype 1.2.3 for signatures), ABIs from @arbitrum/nitro-contracts 3.2.0 (BoLD-era: build/contracts/src/rollup/IRollupCore.sol for the rollup), Multicall3 and ERC-20 from their canonical signatures (viem erc20Abi). aliases: sdk Address.applyAlias, each checked to undo. deposits: EthDepositMessage.calculateDepositTxId, keccak256(0x64 || rlp([chainId, messageNumber as 32 bytes, from, to, value])), from being the aliased depositor as Bridge.MessageDelivered names it (Inbox._deliverToBridge aliases every sender) and to the depositor itself when it is an EOA. retryables: ParentToChildMessage.calculateSubmitRetryableId, keccak256(0x69 || rlp([chainId, messageNumber as 32 bytes, from, l1BaseFee, l1Value, maxFeePerGas, gasLimit, dest or empty for zero, l2CallValue, callValueRefundAddress, maxSubmissionFee, excessFeeRefundAddress, data])). No redeem list: the sdk reads the retry tx hash from RedeemScheduled rather than computing it. submissionFees: Inbox.sol calculateRetryableSubmissionFee, (1400 + 6 * dataLength) * (baseFee == 0 ? block.basefee : baseFee); a zero baseFee row is what the formula gives before the contract substitutes block.basefee. calldata: viem encodeFunctionData, each decoded back; signature is abitype formatAbiItem of the ABI item, args as decimal strings, lowercase hex, "true"/"false", arrays and tuples as JSON arrays in component order. events and answers: viem decodeEventLog (strict) and decodeFunctionResult; named tuples decode to objects, values as strings. Entries marked live are real logs and eth_call answers from Elysium testnet (99801) and HyperEVM testnet (998) on 2026-10-25; the rest are synthetic, built with encodeEventTopics and encodeAbiParameters. transactions: viem serializeTransaction and signTransaction with Hardhat account #0 on chain 99801; signingHash is keccak256 of the unsigned serialization (EIP-155 for legacy). create2: viem getContractAddress, opcode CREATE2.
